|comma list
|_(empty)_

|`+scoretable+`
|text
|_(none)_

[[opts-network]]
== Server and network

Where and how the server listens, who may connect and how much traffic it accepts.

[cols="3,2,2,3,2,7",options="header"]
|===
|Option |Short name |Type |Default |Set from |Description

|[[opt-idleRun]]`+idleRun+`
|`+rawMode+`
|boolean
|`+false+`
|command line, config file
|*Implemented.* Do robots keep on playing even if all human players quit?

|[[opt-noQuit]]`+noQuit+`
|
|boolean
|`+false+`
|command line, config file
|*Implemented.* Does the server wait for new human players to show up after all players have left.

|[[opt-contactPort]]`+contactPort+`
|`+port+`
|integer
|`+15345+`
|command line, config file
|*Implemented.* The server contact port number.

|[[opt-bind]]`+bind+`
|
|comma list
|`+all+`
|command line, config file
|*Implemented.* JXPilot: local addresses to serve on, comma separated: IP literals, host names, interface names, CIDRs, 'loopback' or 'all'. Command line or server config file only. Not visible to clients.

|[[opt-bindWait]]`+bindWait+`
|
|boolean
|`+false+`
|command line, config file
|*Implemented.* JXPilot: wait for a matching interface instead of failing when a bind selector matches nothing. Command line or server config file only.

|[[opt-snapshotDivisor]]`+snapshotDivisor+`
|
|integer
|`+1+`
|command line, config file
|*Implemented.* JXPilot: send a snapshot every this many simulation ticks (frames); 1 = every frame.

|[[opt-radarDivisor]]`+radarDivisor+`
|
|integer
|`+3+`
|command line, config file
|*Implemented.* JXPilot: include the radar in every this many snapshots.

|[[opt-ipPacketRate]]`+ipPacketRate+`
|
|real
|`+400+`
|command line, config file
|*Implemented.* JXPilot: sustained packets per second accepted from one IP address (IPv6: one /64) for connection attempts and packets outside a session.

|[[opt-ipPacketBurst]]`+ipPacketBurst+`
|
|real
|`+800+`
|command line, config file
|*Implemented.* JXPilot: burst size, in packets, of ipPacketRate.

|[[opt-sessionPacketRate]]`+sessionPacketRate+`
|
|real
|`+400+`
|command line, config file
|*Implemented.* JXPilot: sustained packets per second accepted from one connected client.

|[[opt-sessionPacketBurst]]`+sessionPacketBurst+`
|
|real
|`+800+`
|command line, config file
|*Implemented.* JXPilot: burst size, in packets, of sessionPacketRate.

|[[opt-serverHost]]`+serverHost+`
|
|text
|_(none)_
|command line, config file
|*Implemented.* The server's fully qualified domain name (for multihomed hosts).

|[[opt-reportToMetaServer]]`+reportToMetaServer+`
|`+reportMeta+`
|boolean
|`+yes+`
|command line, config file
|*Not supported:* no meta server speaks the JXPilot protocol. Keep the meta server informed about our game?

|[[opt-searchDomainForXPilot]]`+searchDomainForXPilot+`
|
|boolean
|`+no+`
|command line, config file
|*Not supported:* no meta server speaks the JXPilot protocol. Search the local domain for the existence of xpilot.domain?

|[[opt-denyHosts]]`+denyHosts+`
|
|text
|_(empty)_
|command line, config file
|*Implemented.* List of network addresses of computers which are denied service. Each address may optionally be followed by a slash and a network mask.

|[[opt-maxClientsPerIP]]`+maxClientsPerIP+`
|`+maxPerIP+`
|integer
|`+2+`
|command line, config file
|*Implemented.* JXPilot default 4 (XPilot: 2); 0 or less is unlimited; IPv6 counts per /64. Maximum number of clients per IP address that are allowed to connect. This prevents unfriendly players from occupying all the bases, effectively 'kicking' paused players and denying other players to join.

|[[opt-ignore20MaxFPS]]`+ignore20MaxFPS+`
|
|boolean
|`+true+`
|command line, config file
|*Not applicable:* C uses it to ignore the default 20 fps request of C clients; the JXPilot protocol has no frame-rate request, so every client gets every frame (the map's framesPerSecond). Ignore client maxFPS request if it is 20 (the default setting).

|[[opt-pLockServer]]`+pLockServer+`
|
|boolean
|`+false+`
|command line, config file
|*Not applicable:* JVM server (no mlock, no signal timer). Whether the server is prevented from being swapped out of memory.

|[[opt-timerResolution]]`+timerResolution+`
|
|integer
|`+0+`
|command line, config file
|*Not applicable:* JVM server (no mlock, no signal timer). If set to nonzero xpilots will requests signals from the OS at 1/timerResolution second intervals. The server will then compute a new frame FPS times out of every timerResolution signals.

|[[opt-password]]`+password+`
|
|text
|_(none)_
|command line, config file, password file
|*Implemented.* The password needed to obtain operator privileges. If specified on the command line, on many systems other users will be able to see the password. Therefore, using the password file instead is recommended.

|[[opt-clientPortStart]]`+clientPortStart+`
|
|integer
|`+0+`
|command line, config file
|*Not applicable:* one UDP socket per bound address serves every client. Use UDP ports clientPortStart - clientPortEnd (for firewalls)

|[[opt-clientPortEnd]]`+clientPortEnd+`
|
|integer
|`+0+`
|command line, config file
|*Not applicable:* one UDP socket per bound address serves every client. Use UDP ports clientPortStart - clientPortEnd (for firewalls)

|[[opt-maxPauseTime]]`+maxPauseTime+`
|
|seconds
|`+3600+`
|command line, map, config file
|*Implemented.* The maximum time a player can stay paused for, in seconds. After being paused this long, the player will be kicked off. Setting this option to 0 disables the feature.

|===

[[opts-teams]]
== Teams and alliances

Team play and player alliances.

[cols="3,2,2,3,2,7",options="header"]
|===
|Option |Short name |Type |Default |Set from |Description

|[[opt-allowAlliances]]`+allowAlliances+`
|`+alliances+`
|boolean
|`+yes+`
|command line, map, config file
|*Implemented.* Are alliances between players allowed? Alliances are like teams, except they can be formed and dissolved at any time. Notably, teamImmunity and teamShareScore work for alliances too. To manage alliances, use the '/ally' talk command: '/ally invite <player name>' to invite another player to join you. '/ally cancel' to cancel such an invitation. '/ally refuse <player name>' to decline an invitation from a player. '/ally refuse' to decline all the invitations you received. '/ally accept <player name>' to join the other player. '/ally accept' to accept all the invitations you received. '/ally leave' to leave the alliance you are currently in. '/ally list' lists the members of your current alliance. If members from different alliances join, all their allies do so.

|[[opt-announceAlliances]]`+announceAlliances+`
|
|boolean
|`+no+`
|command line, map, config file
|*Implemented.* Are changes in alliances made public? If this option is on, changes in alliances are sent to all players and all alliances are shown in the score list. Invitations for alliances are never sent to anyone but the invited players.

|[[opt-teamPlay]]`+teamPlay+`
|`+teams+`
|boolean
|`+no+`
|command line, map, config file
|*Implemented.* Is the map a team play map?

|[[opt-teamFuel]]`+teamFuel+`
|
|boolean
|`+no+`
|command line, map, config file
|*Implemented.* Are fuelstations only available to team members?

|[[opt-teamCannons]]`+teamCannons+`
|
|boolean
|`+no+`
|command line, map, config file
|*Implemented.* Do cannons choose sides in teamPlay?

|[[opt-teamAssign]]`+teamAssign+`
|
|boolean
|`+yes+`
|command line, map, config file
|*Implemented.* If players have not specified which team they like to join should the server choose a team for them automatically?

|[[opt-teamImmunity]]`+teamImmunity+`
|
|boolean
|`+yes+`
|command line, map, config file
|*Implemented.* Should other team members be immune to various shots thrust etc.? This works for alliances too.

|[[opt-teamShareScore]]`+teamShareScore+`
|
|boolean
|`+no+`
|command line, map, config file
|*Implemented.* Are points gained or lost divided equally over all team members? This works for alliances too.

|

|[[opt-worldLives]]`+worldLives+`
|`+lives+`
|integer
|`+0+`
|command line, map, config file
|*Implemented.* Number of lives each player has (no sense without limitedLives).

|[[opt-reset]]`+reset+`
|
|boolean
|`+yes+`
|command line, map, config file
|*Implemented.* Does the world reset when the end of round is reached? When true all mines, missiles, shots and explosions will be removed from the world and all players including the winner(s) will be transported back to their homebases. This option is only effective when limitedLives is turned on.

|[[opt-resetOnHuman]]`+resetOnHuman+`
|`+humanReset+`
|integer
|`+0+`
|command line, map, config file
|*Implemented.* Normally, new players have to wait until a round is finished before they can start playing. With this option, the first N human players to enter will cause the round to be restarted. In other words, if this option is set to 0, nothing special happens and you have to wait as usual until the round ends (if there are rounds at all, otherwise this option doesn't do anything). If it is set to 1, the round is ended when the first human player enters. This is useful if the robots have already started a round and you don't want to wait for them to finish. If it is set to 2, this also happens for the second human player. This is useful when you got bored waiting for another player to show up and have started playing against the robots. When someone finally joins you, they won't have to wait for you to finish the round before they can play too. For higher numbers it works the same. So this option gives the last human player for whom the round is restarted. Anyone who enters after that does have to wait until the round is over.

|[[opt-wreckageCollisionMayKill]]`+wreckageCollisionMayKill+`
|`+wreckageUnshieldedCollisionKills+`
|boolean
|`+no+`
|command line, map, config file
|*Implemented.* Can ships be destroyed when hit by wreckage?

|command line, map, config file
|*Implemented.* Are players allowed to define their own ship shape?

|
|real

|[[opt-asteroidConcentratorRadius]]`+asteroidConcentratorRadius+`
|`+asteroidConcentratorRange+`
|integer
|`+10+`
|command line, map, config file
|*Implemented.* The maximum distance from an asteroid concentrator for asteroids to appear in. Sensible values are in the range 1 to 20. If no asteroid concentrators are defined in a map then asteroids can popup anywhere. If any are then asteroids popup in the vicinity of an asteroid concentrator with probability asteroidConcentratorProb and anywhere the remainder of the time. An asteroid concentrator is drawn on the screen as three rotating squares. The map symbol is the ampersand '&'.

|[[opt-asteroidConcentratorProb]]`+asteroidConcentratorProb+`
|
|real
|`+1.0+`
|command line, map, config file
|*Implemented.* The probability, if any asteroid concentrators are present, that they will be used. This proportion of asteroids will be placed near asteroid concentrators, within asteroidConcentratorRadius.

[[opts-other]]
== Other options

Options not in any category above.

[cols="3,2,2,3,2,7",options="header"]
|===
|Option |Short name |Type |Default |Set from |Description

|[[opt-lobby]]`+lobby+`
|
|boolean
|`+false+`
|command line, config file
|*Implemented.* JXPilot: run as an always-on lobby server. It offers a list of maps on one UDP port; a client picks one, the lobby starts that map's game if it is not running (or lets the client join it), and a map's game stops when its last human leaves while the lobby keeps running. Command line or server config file only.

|[[opt-lobbyConfig]]`+lobbyConfig+`
|
|text
|_(none)_
|command line, config file
|*Implemented.* JXPilot: the lobby config file: server options for every map before the first [section], then a [mapname] section of per-map options (they override the map file). Only with lobby.

|[[opt-lobbyMapsDir]]`+lobbyMapsDir+`
|
|comma list
|_(empty)_
|command line, config file
|*Implemented.* JXPilot: comma separated directories whose .xp and .map files the lobby offers in addition to the bundled maps. Only with lobby.
